Definition: (only in plural collective) weariness, i.e. (by implication) toil (treasure so obtained) or speed
BiblicalUsage: Strength is the meaning here, and the wealth that strength wins. God brought Israel out of Egypt with the strength of a wild ox, and Eliphaz promises that the Almighty shall be Job's defence and he shall have plenty of silver.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strength and silver are joined here: the strength that delivered Israel and the silver that toil gathers are both called by the same name, and both come from the same hand.
